rooftop_dusk.codex_line: Where the day goes to finish.
rooftop_dusk.codex: The city's upper street: warm slates, honest wind, the last of the sun laid out in stripes. Stand in the right one and a spent thing comes back to you.
rooftop_dusk.name: The Rooftops, Dusk
rooftop_dusk.rule_text: Last light: sunbeams on turns 2 and 4 return a spent card.

needle_lane.codex_line: Our street. The fog knows me.
needle_lane.codex: Home, or what is left of it. The fog comes up from the Mere most nights, and I move through it like a rumor — the lane taught me how.
needle_lane.name: Needle Lane, Night

parlor_cold.codex: The parlor after. Her stitching is still in the walls, and the moonlight still remembers the way in.
parlor_cold.name: The Parlor
parlor_cold.rule_text: Her room remembers her: Moonlight costs 1 less.

parlor_warm.codex: The parlor as it was: kettle on, needle going, everything in the world in its right place.
parlor_warm.name: The Parlor, Before

needle_lane_wrong.codex_line: The night the lamps went out.
needle_lane_wrong.codex: The dark on the lane that night was not weather. I knew it, and I went in anyway.
needle_lane_wrong.name: Needle Lane, Wrong
needle_lane_wrong.rule_text: The lamps are out. The dark is deeper than it should be.

hollow_court.codex: Where cats go between lives: all filing and no building. Nothing hurts there, which I find deeply suspicious.
hollow_court.name: The Hollow Court
hollow_court.rule_text: No sun has ever reached this desk.

back_gardens.codex: Garden walls and dark windows. Claws are loud here, and the houses keep geese on retainer.
back_gardens.name: The Back Gardens
back_gardens.rule_text: Sleeping houses: Ferocity costs 1 more and raises the Alarm.

wickrow_night.codex_line: The Chandlers' streets, lit on purpose.
wickrow_night.codex: Ward-light on every corner. Honest light is the hardest kind to work in.
wickrow_night.name: Wickrow, Under Ward-Light
wickrow_night.rule_text: Ward-lit streets: Moonlight costs 1 more; Guile 1 less.

counting_house.codex: Ledgers and locked drawers. Money sleeps lighter than people do, and screams louder when woken.
counting_house.name: The Counting-House, After Hours
counting_house.rule_text: Sleeping money: Ferocity costs 1 more and raises the Alarm.

mereside_edge.codex: The edge of the Mere, where the fog is thickest and the shore does not entirely agree where it is. Keep your voice down.
mereside_edge.name: The Mereside, Fog
mereside_edge.rule_text: The Mere's breath: Shadow costs 1 less. The water is listening.

guildhall.codex: The Chandlers' own hall. Every candle in it is a small law, lit.
guildhall.name: The Chandlers' Guildhall
guildhall.rule_text: The guild's own light: Moonlight costs 1 more; Guile 1 less.

wickhouse.codex: The old wickhouse. Her stitching runs through the brick — the nearest thing I have left to a place that is still hers.
wickhouse.name: The Wickhouse
wickhouse.rule_text: Her stitching holds these walls: Moonlight costs 1 less.

shambles_market.codex: The market after hours, where half the city's business waits for the other half to go home.
shambles_market.name: The Shambles, After Hours
shambles_market.rule_text: Everything is negotiable: Guile costs 1 less.
